# C# and .NET Standards
- Always prefer primary constructors when defining C# 12+ classes.
- Use strongly-typed configurations over configuration strings.
- Ensure all public methods have descriptive XML documentation.
- all api endpoints MUST include a "tfc-" prefix
- Always update the http file whenever you add or change an endpoint
- Always update the test project to match the new state or the project.
- Always update the README.md file with changes you made.
